policy.deterministic: Run on every matching change and in the default test lane.
policy.comparison: Paid, explicitly gated trend evidence. It may compare a change but cannot qualify a release.
policy.release: Paid, explicitly gated and fail-closed. A missing release lane is recorded as a gap, not inferred from green smoke tests.

entries.rationale: Prompt and loop changes can alter ordinary answers, tool use, completion evidence, latency, and cost.
comparison: SHANNON_E2E_LIVE=1 KOCORO_AGENT_LAB_QUALITY_LIVE=1 KOCORO_AGENT_LAB_QUALITY_SAMPLE=smoke KOCORO_AGENT_LAB_QUALITY_REPETITIONS=3 go test -tags=live ./test/e2e -run '^TestLive_AgentLabGeneralPurposeQuality$' -count=1

SHANNON_E2E_LIVE=1 KOCORO_GENERAL_OUTCOME_LIVE=1 KOCORO_GENERAL_OUTCOME_SAMPLE=comparison KOCORO_GENERAL_OUTCOME_REPETITIONS=1 go test -tags=live ./test/e2e -run '^TestLive_GeneralAgentOutcomeDataset$' -count=1
release: SHANNON_E2E_LIVE=1 KOCORO_AGENT_LAB_QUALITY_LIVE=1 KOCORO_AGENT_LAB_QUALITY_SAMPLE=release KOCORO_AGENT_LAB_QUALITY_REPETITIONS=15 go test -tags=live ./test/e2e -run '^TestLive_AgentLabGeneralPurposeQuality$' -count=1

SHANNON_E2E_LIVE=1 KOCORO_GENERAL_OUTCOME_LIVE=1 KOCORO_GENERAL_OUTCOME_SAMPLE=release KOCORO_GENERAL_OUTCOME_REPETITIONS=5 go test -tags=live ./test/e2e -run '^TestLive_GeneralAgentOutcomeDataset$' -count=1

entries.rationale: A schema or description change must preserve argument validity, narrow tool choice, verified results, and side-effect state.
comparison: SHANNON_E2E_LIVE=1 KOCORO_TOOL_CHOICE_LIVE=1 KOCORO_TOOL_CHOICE_SAMPLE=comparison KOCORO_TOOL_CHOICE_REPETITIONS=3 go test -tags=live ./test/e2e -run '^TestLive_ToolChoiceMatrix$' -count=1
release: SHANNON_E2E_LIVE=1 KOCORO_TOOL_CHOICE_LIVE=1 KOCORO_TOOL_CHOICE_SAMPLE=release KOCORO_TOOL_CHOICE_REPETITIONS=5 go test -tags=live ./test/e2e -run '^TestLive_ToolChoiceMatrix$' -count=1

entries.rationale: Fast/Full changes need equivalent outcomes before latency or cost improvements count.
comparison: SHANNON_E2E_LIVE=1 KOCORO_FAST_PINNED_AB=1 KOCORO_FAST_PINNED_AB_SAMPLE=comparison KOCORO_FAST_PINNED_AB_REPETITIONS=3 go test -tags=live ./test/e2e -run '^TestLive_FastPinnedVsFullAB$' -count=1
release: SHANNON_E2E_LIVE=1 KOCORO_FAST_PINNED_AB=1 KOCORO_FAST_PINNED_AB_SAMPLE=release KOCORO_FAST_PINNED_AB_REPETITIONS=15 go test -tags=live ./test/e2e -run '^TestLive_FastPinnedVsFullAB$' -count=1

entries.rationale: Memory changes must preserve facts, trust boundaries, retrieval routing, and state across a compaction boundary.
Daemon changes need protocol/state coverage plus a real streamed reply; current channel probes do not prove remote delivery.
Mechanism tests cover MCP lifecycle; the paid outcome lane qualifies deterministic cross-page reading and exactly-once form submission without depending on public websites.
Realtime probes cover synthetic audio and mocked result routing; no lane qualifies physical microphone, speaker, AEC, or barge-in behavior.
The live probe now verifies semantic reading of a controlled screenshot, but no release lane yet proves a verified desktop action outcome.
The paid lane checks Cloud/CDN transport plus deterministic red-circle and bottom-right blue-square pixel oracles; it is a narrow regression gate, not a general aesthetic score.
Harness changes must compile both build-tag surfaces and keep paid/release lanes explicit and fail-closed.
